summary: Wan Animate 2 (Alibaba) — motion transfer. A driving video's CHOREOGRAPHY is copied onto a character image; the driving pixels never appear. This is the cure for the invented-smoke failure, because there is no vacuum for the model to fill.
vramNote: ESTIMATE and probably LOW. Weights are 23GB in int8, but video VRAM is dominated by ACTIVATIONS, not weights — the measured hunyuan-1.5 run peaked at 46GB off a 16.65GB unet. Measure before trusting.
bf16Alternative: wan_animate_2_bf16.safetensors is 30.54GB (total stack 38GB). Take it if the int8 shows artefacts — quantisation is a precision trade, and Ryan's eyes decide whether it cost anything.
note: Published to Comfy-Org with 0 downloads as of 2026-08-12 — brand new, so expect thin community documentation. The older wan2.2_animate_14B_bf16 (32.18GB) in Wan_2.2_ComfyUI_Repackaged is the proven-by-volume fallback.
